earnings.title: Enbridge Reports Strong Third Quarter Results, Places Over $3 Billion of Gas Transmission Projects Into Service, and Reaffirms 2026 Financial Guidance
highlights: Distributable cash flow (DCF)* of $2.7 billion, compared with $2.6 billion in 2025
Our secured growth backlog stands at $38 billion, even as we placed $3 billion of completed projects into service this quarter.
We've consistently added new projects to our backlog this year, positioning us well to deliver on our $10–20 billion target for new project announcements through 2027.
With our extensive incumbent footprint, $38 billion secured capital backlog and growing annual investment capacity, we are well positioned to support increasing energy demand.
outlook: Our focus remains on executing our secured backlog and extending visibility to our 5% growth outlook.
The Company reaffirms its 2026 financial guidance for adjusted EBITDA between $20.2 billion and $20.8 billion and DCF per share between $5.70 and $6.10.
The Company also reaffirms its medium-term outlook for adjusted EBITDA, DCF per share, and EPS average compound annual growth rate of approximately 5%.
On October 28, 2026, Enbridge Gas North Carolina completed a US$500 million medium-term note offering consisting of US$250 million of 10-year notes and US$250 million of 30-year notes.
